Watches the paths declared in dataverse.yaml. When one changes, only that component is
built and diffed: a saved web resource does not rebuild the plugin assemblies.

usage:
  dverse watch [options]

options:
  --plan             report what would change instead of writing it
  --debounce <ms>    quiet period before converging (default 300)
  --all              watch the full configured scope, not just the current directory
  --no-prune         keep environment-only components instead of deleting them
  --no-batch         one request per write instead of parallel $batch changesets
  --env <name>       environment to converge; otherwise the usual resolution applies

not watched, by design:
  schema:            metadata writes are not an inner-loop operation
  seed:              declared in dataverse.yaml, which needs a restart anyway
  the model snapshot is not refreshed per converge — run plan or apply for that

Versions are never auto-bumped here: incrementing AssemblyVersion on every save would
rewrite the csproj continuously. Run apply before you commit.

Stop with Ctrl+C.

  dverse auth list                              show persisted sign-ins (org + account)

  dverse model sync --entities a,b [--env <name>]   refresh dataverse.snapshot.json from metadata
  dverse plan  [--json] [--no-prune[=kinds]] [--no-build] [--all] [--assembly <dll>] [--package [--package-id <id>]] [--env <name>]
